verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own cross-meeting search: AI Chat searches across your meetings, natural-language search finds insights from past calls, transcripts are searchable, and transcripts can be searched across all time periods. A community user also says it is great for going back to details from past meetings. Nothing shows jumping to the exact timestamp or moment in a recording, and explicit in-product search of summaries and notes as distinct fields is not documented. Missing for 10: documented jump-to-timestamp from search results, explicit search across summaries and notes in-product, independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
they'll be automatically transcribed into searchable and shareable text
finds it great for going back to details they didn't take notes on
